version.changelog: Add free signup, 500-credit Setup, and prepaid fetcher-key onboarding; remove legacy payment flow.

llm.summary: This skill is a read-only guide for querying public Google Play data through ReplyNodes and does not include hidden execution, persistence, or write access.

dimensions.detail: Use requires outbound requests to api.replynodes.com with a ReplyNodes API key and prepaid credits, which is proportionate to the API-integration purpose but should be controlled by the user.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown documentation only, with no executable scripts, dependencies, hooks, or install-time commands.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions explicitly prohibit Google credentials, cookies, OAuth sessions, publishing, private data access, catalog enumeration, and write operations; they also require bounded pagination and URL-encoded parameters.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The only persistent sensitive item is the user-created ReplyNodes API key stored in an agent secret store; no system persistence, services, scheduled tasks, or privilege escalation are requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is public Android app research, and the artifact limits use to documented read-only GET routes for app metadata, reviews, permissions, availability, and similar public data.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you are comfortable using a ReplyNodes API key and prepaid credits for public Google Play lookups. Keep the key in a secret store, set explicit limits for batch or review pagination, and do not provide Google account credentials or session data to this skill.
